---
title: "Lightbox: true"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/pandoc-figure.qmd:
# `lightbox: true` is automatic mode; a captioned figure is wrapped and its
# caption becomes the link title.
lightbox: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'a.lightbox[title="A Lovely Image"][href="images/mv-0.png"] > img'
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - 'script src="[^"]*glightbox/glightbox\.min\.js"'
          - 'class="quarto-figure quarto-figure-center">\s*.figure>\s*.a href="images/mv-0\.png" class="lightbox"'
        - []
---

![A Lovely Image](images/mv-0.png)
